Weighting applies to the location of the point, not translation weights. Availability varies by reporting level and vintage. Workplace centroids use census workers; they are not BRES job-weighted points.

File format, delivery & lookup method

Download tags reflect indexed links or publisher metadata, rather than a live file check. Publisher downloads may need time to generate. A service alone does not confirm a download.

Reference year ≠ publication year. Lookups can refer to several vintages. Search and year filters keep all of them; source upload dates remain separate.

Search finds datasets and download bundles. Audited combined-authority names and codes are searchable; other individual polygon names are not indexed.

England is selected first; switch to Wales or another country to inspect its reporting levels. Census years, administrative snapshots and unlabelled current sources are kept separate.

Numbers count indexed source records, not polygons. Select a cell to find its files. A dash is an index gap, not evidence of abolition or a boundary change. “Earlier” includes support vintages for reporting around 2010.

Not found

No indexed files for these reporting rows under the selected filters, across all reference vintages including “Earlier” and “Not labelled”. Try another product or boundary detail. This does not mean the geography was abolished. These rows remain in the coverage CSV.

    These cells do not certify annual legal validity. Statistical areas may remain in use for many years. A country can be covered by a shared UK / GB / England & Wales file.

    Official sources

    Mayoral and strategic authorities

    Use the Mayoral authorities preset for combined authorities, combined county authorities and Greater London. CCA features sit inside shared ONS combined-authority files; those bundles are indexed under both levels where their names and codes confirm coverage.

    The latest dated ONS polygon snapshot in this index is December 2025. Authorities created in 2026 are not automatically present in that file. Their establishment orders appear under Reference files / names & codes; a newer upload date does not update the boundary vintage.

    Some combined authorities are non-mayoral, and a council with an elected mayor retains its LAD boundary. A mayoral development corporation is a different, smaller development geography.

    Official devolution report

    Different census systems

    England and Wales use OA, LSOA and MSOA. Scotland uses OA, Data Zones and Intermediate Zones. Northern Ireland’s 2011 Small Areas and SOAs differ from its new 2021 Data Zones and Super Data Zones.

    The index includes 2001 reference products where needed for reporting around 2010. Scotland’s latest census geography is 2022; England, Wales and Northern Ireland use 2021.

    Track changes using the right evidence

    Names, GSS codes, council structures, legal boundary changes and revised geometry can change independently. Use the ONS Code History Database alongside the dated files and the relevant official boundary order.

    Code History Database guidance · Official legislation

    Kirklees, decoded

    E08000034 · Metropolitan district · West Yorkshire. Kirklees is a single-tier metropolitan council. Its official category is distinct from E06 unitary authorities. It sits within West Yorkshire metropolitan county and the West Yorkshire Combined Authority.

    A metropolitan district, metropolitan county, combined authority and functional urban area are different geographies. MSOA is a separate census reporting level. Find local-authority files under LAD / UA / council areas / LGD.

    ONS Kirklees profile · ONS authority categories · West Yorkshire Combined Authority
    Preparing files for spatial translation

    Use full resolution geometry and consistent coastal definitions. BFE describes full extent of the realm; BFC describes full geometry clipped at mean high water. BGC and BSC are generalised products. Check each source’s CRS and licence.

    Keep source code and vintage, target code and vintage, relationship and weighting method in your own package. Exact-fit aggregation, best-fit assignments, area matching and population matching are different operations. A lookup without weights does not justify population-weighted translation.

    CSV and JSON exports contain metadata and download links. Geometry is downloaded from its official publisher; it is not re-hosted here.

    ONS geography guidance
    Coverage limits and source audit

    Rows with no indexed files under the selected filters appear in “Not found”. Annual local boundary orders, every cartographic revision, local bespoke reporting areas, and census-to-census weights are not exhaustively indexed. Unlabelled current layers are not backfilled into earlier years.

    England’s regions and UK ITL / historic NUTS regions have separate entries. The four nations do not share one administrative hierarchy. Welsh Senedd 2026 and earlier Assembly geographies are separate vintages.
